scope: Ordinary non-premium non-elite shared visual routes. Cost bands use base EntityDef cost. Large included for diagnostic coverage. No client execution.
timing_semantics: Times are continuous-time reconstruction; Unity/PlayMaker update scheduling can add frame quantization.
Parallel actions enter in source action index order. Explicit named events can transition before other actions finish.
AnimationPlaythroughAction starts playback then finishes immediately; PlayAnimation normally waits.
SpellFinishAction finishes Card callback without ending FSM; None-state SpellStateAction also finishes if necessary.
64-bit PPtr path IDs are decimal strings. Raw FSM files preserve original wrappers and unresolved serialized values.
Do not substitute m_MuscleClip.m_StopTime=1 when m_MuscleClipSize=0; duration estimates use actual legacy curve bounds.
